# ankra_ci_pool_member (Resource)

A cluster listed in the organisation's CI cluster pool, sharing pipeline runs by weight. The counterpart of `ankra org ci-settings pool add` and `pool remove`. Changes need organisation admin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_ci_pool_member" "spare" {
  cluster_id = "5f6e7d8c-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  weight     = 50
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster to list. It must belong to the organisation and be able to run pipeline steps.

### Optional

- `weight` (Number) Relative share of runs, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 100.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_name` (String) Cluster name.
- `id` (String) The cluster id.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether the cluster is also the organisation's pipeline cluster (`ci_cluster_id`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Pool members are imported by cluster id.
terraform import ankra_ci_pool_member.spare 5f6e7d8c-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
